dedupe_keys.name: cartografia de inundabilidad de la capv basque country flood mapping

description: The Basque Government produced this flood mapping of the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country (CAPV), which shows the floodable zones for return periods of 10, 100 and 500 years, prepared under the Basque water law, the public hydraulic domain regulation and the EU Floods Directive. Coverage is the Basque Country in Spain. The maps are a free download from Open Data Euskadi, with ISO 19115 metadata and a viewer of the Basque Water Agency, and any use is allowed if the Basque Government is credited. Caveats: the page gives neither the date of the mapping nor an update frequency, and the page describes flood zones only, without water depths. Simulation uses: flood extents by return period for exposure of water and other infrastructure. Related records: Luxembourg's flood hazard maps (data-luxembourg-flood-and-heavy-rainfall-hazard-maps).
licence: any use allowed with attribution to Eusko Jaurlaritza / Gobierno Vasco
